context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 聴け/ダラダラ/働け/蹴っ/滑らか/呑み/噛ん/食費

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、講演会、行ける時は、聴けば、必ず学びがあるぞ。
lines.en: Sakura — lectures, when you can go, you always learn something from listening.
lines.style: Steady, encouraging tone. Speaking from experience. Not quite mentor-lecturing but close—warm conviction without being heavy. Slight pause after her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。試験前、ダラダラする時間、減らします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll cut down on procrastinating before tests.
lines.style: Straightforward agreement. A light nod in her voice. She means it—not automatic politeness, but genuine assent. Sits with the commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 若いうちに、よく働けば、後で楽になる。
lines.en: Work hard while you're young, and things get easier later.
lines.style: Simple wisdom delivered gently, not as lecture. Speaking from a place of quiet experience. Slight weight to the words—he's said versions of this before, maybe to himself.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。試合中、先輩、力強くボール、蹴ってましたね。
lines.en: Yeah. At the match the other day—senpai was kicking the ball with real power.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost wondering aloud. A small shift in energy—she's noticed something, bringing it up naturally, not jumping topics. Genuine observation trying out the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論文の文章、滑らかに書ける?
lines.en: Can you write your paper prose smoothly?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, checking in. Warm but direct. He's asking because he wants to know, not because he expects a set answer. Slight lean-in quality.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。打ち上げで、ジュース、呑みすぎちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah. I had too much juice at the after-party, actually.
lines.style: Dry, slightly self-aware. A small laugh underneath. She's not upset about it—more gently mocking herself. Trailing off a bit, admitting the small embarrassment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 食事、よく噛んで食べろよ、健康にいい。
lines.en: I drink too much juice at after-parties.
lines.style: This line repeats the previous turn—likely needs context review. Delivering with the same dry self-awareness but shorter. Light, self-deprecating.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 仕送りと食費、両親に、感謝しています。
lines.en: I'm really grateful to my parents for supporting me with allowance and food.
lines.style: Genuine, quiet sincerity. Not performative gratitude—this lands as real feeling. Slightly vulnerable in how carefully she says it. Respectful but not stiff.
